newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Ayala Land succumbs to foreign selldown.
newsitem.headline: Ayala Land succumbs to foreign selldown.

text.p: Real estate firm Ayala Land Inc succumbed to heavy foreign selling in early trade with its share price falling by 1.50 pesos, or 7.14 percent, to 19.50 pesos, brokers said.
Ayala Land is an index heavyweight and it was one of the stocks which pulled the entire market down. The bourse's main index was down by 120.42 points, or 4.24 percent, to 2,716.89.
Brokers said property and banking stocks were the worst hit. The downtrend was fuelled by fears Philippine banks had too many loans to the overheated property sector.
